key_insight: A transformer-based transfer learning model with uncertainty estimates can accurately screen greener solvent substitutes from very limited solubility data.
engineering_relevance: The tool helps organic and hybrid photovoltaics researchers quickly rank and integrate eco-friendlier solvents into high-throughput materials workflows.
method: Pre-train on QM9 targets, then transfer to solvent-property prediction with minimal new data.
Add uncertainty quantification so users can judge prediction confidence.
Predict key solubility descriptors such as Hansen parameters, dielectric constant, and Gutmann donor/acceptor numbers.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong performance on established solvent-property datasets and on data-scarce targets, while also rediscovering known green solvents and proposing new candidates.
watch_item: Predictions still depend on the quality and domain match of the limited training data, so low-confidence outputs should be treated cautiously in screening decisions.
paper_title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
